title: Instant Coffee, Pre‑Sweetened with Sugar, Not Reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: Instant coffee that is pre‑sweetened with sugar does not require any additional water to become a ready‑to‑drink beverage. It is made from roasted coffee beans, from which a flavorful extract is obtained and then dried by freeze‑drying or spray‑drying, with sugar added for instant sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first commercial instant coffee was patented in the early 20th century.
Pre‑sweetened instant coffee is popular in military rations and backpacking meals because of its convenience.
Sugar masks bitterness and creates a smoother taste profile.
Freeze‑drying preserves more aromatic compounds than traditional drying methods.
Instant coffee can contain up to 30 % of the caffeine found in an equivalent amount of ground coffee.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals in the body.

items.title: Improves alertness
items.content: Caffeine enhances vigilance and may temporarily boost cognitive performance.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine can increase metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Reduced risk of certain diseases
items.content: Moderate, regular coffee consumption is associated with lower risk of Parkinson’s disease and some cancers.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Sugar provides an immediate source of glucose, useful during intense physical activity.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Excessive intake may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of type‑2 diabetes.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Large doses can cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to coffee components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcer disease.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Prepare by adding a measured scoop of the product to hot water (about 200 ml) and stirring. It can also be used as a sweetener in desserts, sauces, or cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package, protected from moisture and direct sunlight. After opening, use within 3‑6 months for best quality.
